{"consolidated_memory":"Flaky jobs in build/ci/pipeline.yml (two separate incidents)

**Occasion 1: [2026-01-25]**
- Component: build/ci/pipeline.yml
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Reproduction: rerun same commit ten times
- Signal: one job failing on minority of runs
- Outcome: nightly rollup matched source counts for 52 days running
- Fix: switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #3953, branch fix/flaky-job-1

**Occasion 2: [2026-08-28]**
- Component: build/ci/pipeline.yml (same corner as occasion 1)
- Trigger: traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root cause: off-by-one in slice bound
- Reproduction: rerun same commit ten times
- Signal: one job failing on minority of runs
- Outcome: memory settled at 536 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB
- Fix: corrected the bound and added property test around it
- PR #8504, branch fix/flaky-job-2

Both incidents affected the same area of the build system; context from occasion 1 carried over to occasion 2."}
